jobs.occupation: Chief Engineer (m/f/d) Business Unit Boeing, Telair International GmbH (Business-Unit Leiter/in)
jobs.description: Join us in shaping the aviation of tomorrow! As part of a globally operating group, we are among the world's leading companies in the development and production of innovative cargo solutions for the aviation industry. With passion, the highest standards of quality, and the courage to innovate, we create solutions that move the world and make us a strong partner to the most renowned aircraft manufacturers. Become part of our team in Miesbach and shape with us the future of aviation!   Chief Engineer (m/f/d) Business Unit Boeing YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES You take overall technical responsibility for all projects within the Business Unit Boeing. You lead and coordinate interdisciplinary engineering teams in alignment with the Vice President Engineering and the Business Unit Manager. You own the system architecture and define the technical solution strategy. You lead and coordinate interdisciplinary engineering teams. You ensure compliance with all requirements regarding quality, cost, schedule, and risk. You are accountable for requirements management, system design, integration, and verification & validation. You prepare and lead technical reviews (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR). You collaborate closely with project management, customers, partners, and certification authorities. You drive the continuous improvement of engineering processes, methods, and standards. YOUR QUALIFICATIONS As the ideal candidate, you hold a master's degree in electrical engineering or a comparable qualification. You have more than 5 years of professional experience within aerospace development and technical leadership. You have basic understanding of EASA Certification Rules (CS25) and Part21J regulations. You demonstrate strong analytical and conceptual skills. You show a high level of decision-making ability and excellent communication skills. You have experience in international projects; this is considered an advantage. You communicate confidently in English, and you benefit from additional German language skills. OUR BENEFITS Flexibility and Hybrid Working. We know that flexibility in the workplace is crucial. That's why we offer flexible working hours and hybrid working models, depending on the area of work. This allows you to balance your professional and personal life optimally. Personal Development. Stagnation? Not with us! We support your professional development through targeted training, further education opportunities, and educational leave. Your potential is our drive! Compensation and Benefits. In addition to performance-based compensation, we offer an attractive company-funded pension plan. You will also benefit from employee discounts and subsidies, such as for work clothing, safety shoes, and daily meals. Wellbeing.Your health and well-being are important to us! With offers like bike leasing through JobRad and access to Wellpass, we support you in staying active and healthy. Additionally, our employee assistance program meinEAP is available to provide professional help with health, professional, and personal challenges. Submit your application now with all required documents!

jobs.occupation: Digital Guest Service / Customer Support Supervisor (all genders) Hospitality in Berlin (Reservierungssachbearbeiter/in (Hotel))
jobs.description: We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.Homaris exists to solve one of the most persistent problems in modern cities: People from abroad need places to live, work, and just feel at home. We build and operate fully digitised serviced apartments across Germany´s major cities – next step: Europe and beyond.And a product vision — the nanopartment® — that reimagines what urban stays can look like in the smallest possible space. Revenue triples within two years — organically. No venture capital. No exit strategy. We are in this for the long run, and we build accordingly. Extraordinary people make this happen - and we're looking for one more.Your RoleYou run the operational core of our digital guest service. Working from our Berlin headquarters, you join the Guest Service Supervisor team as the central point of contact for our Guest Service Agents worldwide. You make sure guests experience reliable care, and you free up the teams who speak with them every day. At the helm of our digital front desk, you keep every guest stay running smoothly behind the scenes.What You'll Do Operations. You support the Guest Service team in day-to-day work and keep our apartments running smoothly from behind the scenes.Quality. You design new quality concepts, monitor compliance with our standards in guest communication, and train the Agents continuously.Communication. You draft message templates that reach our guests reliably, personally and in the right tone.Second Level. You are the go-to contact for Agents when a case gets complex, and you take ownership when it matters most.Onboarding. You support the onboarding of new colleagues and the ongoing development of existing team members.Deputising. You cover for the Guest Service Team Lead during absences and keep the entire team in view.Interfaces. You coordinate closely with internal departments and external service partners, as a dependable partner who sees solutions through.What Makes You a Fit Service with Standards. You have a strong service mindset and are comfortable working at different times of day, including weekends on a regular, planned rotation.Experience. You bring professional experience as a Reservation Agent or Manager, Call Center Agent, Receptionist, or from another service-driven industry.Organisation. You organise and coordinate with confidence and approach problems with a solution-first mindset.Communication. You connect easily with different personalities and convey points of view, ideas and solutions clearly.Digital Tools. You work with software and digital solutions effortlessly. Experience with booking platforms and the property management systems Apaleo or Guesty is a plus.Languages. You speak and write German and English fluently (both at C1).Digital Curiosity. You spot potential in new tools and are excited about how AI can make your daily work more efficient.The EnvironmentHomaris is a company with the maximum of long-term orientation. We don't burn cash to grow fast and sell. We build something real, and we expect the people who join us to want to build it with us — not to optimise for others. The pace is high. The problems are real. The team is small enough that every person matters. We're not always great at seeing and celebrating our wins. Short DescriptionSPREAD builds Engineering Intelligence for complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes and industrial manufacturers one connected view of their product data, and Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Bosch and Rheinmetall already run it. We are backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia and Salesforce, won the SPARK AI Innovation Award, and made LinkedIn's Top Startups in DACH list.Role: Getting a first meeting with an engineering director at an OEM is the hardest step in our funnel, and this role owns it. You sit between Business Development and Revenue Operations, report to our Head of Revenue, and work every day with the BDRs and Account Executives. Half your time goes to pipeline, which means finding the right accounts and people and building the plays that reach them; the other half goes to the engine behind those plays, which you build with Claude Code rather than by hand, so the sales team spends its hours in conversations instead of research and data entry. Your work counts when it turns into meetings and pipeline, not when another dashboard ships. The person we picture did BDR or SDR work, liked the tooling and the process more than the cold calls, and now builds agents because they want to.Your Mission• Design, launch, and test outbound plays into automotive and industrial engineering accounts, each with a hypothesis and a conversion number, track each play from first touch to qualified opportunity, and retire the ones that do not convert.• Run cadences across email, phone and LinkedIn in German and English together with the BDRs and AEs, and write first touches good enough that the reps reuse them.• Turn our Account News feed, which scores news, hiring and leadership changes every night, into meetings with the people those signals point to.• Build account maps, contact scores and segments for campaigns and events, so every play starts from the right twenty people rather than the right two thousand.• Run Clay enrichment triggered from Salesforce, so reps get emails, phone numbers and titles without asking anyone.• Build the AI agents the sales team uses every week (meeting prep, account research, post-call Salesforce updates, outreach drafts) and win adoption through short demos, an agent of the week, and fixing whatever made people stop using one.• Extend our GTM dashboard, a Next.js app on Vercel that reads Salesforce, with the funnel, BDR activity and account penetration views Business Development needs.• Keep the funnel data in Salesforce clean, from leads and contacts to campaigns, activity capture, and attribution, so the numbers in every pipeline review hold up.• Run the content engine for sales, from the Brand Hub to the tooling that turns Product Marketing's material into decks, films and one-pagers a rep can send the same dayWhat success looks like in the first 12 months• After 3 months, two outbound plays are live end to end with reported conversion, Clay enrichment and the BD funnel view are yours, and you write our first touches yourself.• After 6 months, the BDRs run a play library without you, the whole sales team uses one of your agents every week, and qualified pipeline traces back to your plays.• After 12 months, you are the person everyone asks "how do we get into this account?", and the top-of-funnel engine runs every week without a push.Your Experience Must-have• 2 to 4 years in B2B go-to-market as a BDR, SDR, growth or sales ops hire at a startup or scale-up.• Meetings you booked yourself, so you know what a good first call feels like from the rep's side.• Automations in Clay, n8n, Zapier or Make that other people relied onSomething you shipped with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or a similar AI coding tool, and daily work with Claude or ChatGPT.• Salesforce at a working level, meaning reports, fields, list views and basic flows.• A habit of running experiments (hypothesis, small test, numbers, next step) and a preference for launching something rough on Tuesday over polishing it for a month.• Fluent German and English, since most of our outreach goes to German engineering leaders.Strong plus• SQL or SOQL, Python or TypeScript.• Salesforce admin experience, or time in Salesloft, Apollo, or HubSpot.• Experience selling to automotive, manufacturing, or engineering-software buyers.• A side project, newsletter, or LinkedIn presence that shows you can create demandWhy SPREAD?You sell AI for engineering to the biggest names in automotive and industry, with a product that customers run in production. Our reps already work with Claude agents, and you build the next ones, so what you ship on Monday is in front of the sales team by Wednesday. You have a direct line to the founders and the sales leaders, and your plays get discussed rather than filed. We pay competitively and add an annual learning budget, workation options, a Deutschlandticket mobility budget and Urban Sports Club. You get 30 vacation days plus one paid volunteering day a year, and lunch at the Berlin office three times a week.How we hire: A 30-minute call, a 3-hour work sample you do on your own time, two or three interviews, and references. From first call to offer usually takes less than a month.ContactDmytro İefymenkorecruiting@spread.aiSPREAD AIKöpenicker Str. 40c | 10179 BerlinStay connected—follow us on LinkedIn for the latest insights and updatesAbout usSPREAD is pioneering Agentic Engineering Intelligence . The SOS Children's Villages worldwide Hermann-Gmeiner-Fonds Deutschland e.V. is an independent, non-denominational children's rights organization. With its headquarters in Munich and offices in Berlin and Düsseldorf, the organization has been supporting the global projects of SOS Children's Villages since 1963. 200 employees are committed to the vision of "For a world that lets you grow". With almost 3,000 programs in over 130 countries, the organization offers help to children, young people and families in need through education, medical care and family strengthening. The focus is on strengthening the family, sustainability, children's rights and cultural sensitivity.   International Operations manages the funding of our international partner's projects. We work with internal and external bodies to ensure that donations are used appropriately and provide reporting. For this department we are looking for a Finance Manager for Project Funding (f/m/d) for our Munich or Berlin office. This is a full-time position (38,5 hours per week) available immediately. The position has a fixed term to cover parental leave. Your tasks Working alongside our programme departments, you will review funding applications from our international partners, focusing on project budgets. You will prepare funding agreements and submit them to our Board for approval. This ensures that donations are used to support effective projects in areas such as child and youth care and family strengthening.  You will also be responsible for arranging the transfer of funds. During project implementation by our partners, you will check their budgets, reports and audits. This will ensure that our funds are used for their intended purpose and support project change management.  You will work closely with colleagues from our programme departments and act as the main point of contact for several of our international partners on financial matters.  As part of a major overhaul of our grant-making processes, you will introduce and develop new procedures with our partners. To this end, you will be involved in internal change projects.  You will assist with internal monitoring and reporting, including quarterly forecasts and annual budgeting.  You will also support our fundraising efforts and annual audit by providing analysis and financial information. Your profile A degree in Business Studies or equivalent with a solid professional grounding in numbers and financial processes. Experience in financial controlling and accounting, as well as in the not-for-profit sector, would be advantageous but is not required. Your excellent English skills enable you to understand complex subjects and express yourself confidently. The ability to speak and write French is advantageous. You also have a good command of German. Experience of working in the field of international development cooperation in West Asia or West Africa would be an advantage. You are eager to learn, and you are interested in understanding complex structures. You can work independently and enjoy working in a team. You can recognise when each type of work is required. You know how to navigate difficult situations and find mutually beneficial solutions. You have excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly in Excel.   Knowledge of digital project management and accounting systems such as SAP would be an advantage. jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Join our dynamic team and immerse yourself in the exciting world of power systems and controls! You will build transient models for grid-connected converters and plants, including renewable energy systems, battery energy storage systems (BESS), HVDC, FACTS, and microgrids. Imagine defining and developing controller concepts that enhance the performance of converter-based assets, from inner controls to plant-level energy management. You will investigate the interactions among various systems, ensuring robust performance during normal operations and faults. Your expertise will drive innovation as you apply data analytics and AI/ML methods for predictive maintenance and load forecasting, all while mentoring the next generation of engineers in this critical field.How You’ll Make an Impact * Develop and validate transient models for converter-based grid assets, including renewables, BESS, HVDC, FACTS, industrial loads, data centers, and microgrids* Design, tune, and assess control strategies from converter inner controls to plant-level energy management and supervisory functions* Implement grid-following and grid-forming controls, including synchronization, voltage/frequency support, and fault ride-through capabilities* Analyze interactions between converter controls, plant controllers, and protection systems to optimize system performance and reliability* Perform dynamic, transient, and small-signal studies to evaluate system behavior and support controller tuning in weak and low-inertia grids* Apply advanced analytics and AI/ML techniques for forecasting, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, while providing technical leadership and mentoringWhat You Bring* Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Power Systems, Control Engineering, or a related field with a focus on power systems and controls* Extensive professional experience in power-system modeling and studies, including development and validation of RMS and EMT models* Strong understanding of power-system dynamics, stability, fault response, and control interactions* Practical expertise in converter-based technologies and control architectures, including grid-following and grid-forming controls* Proficiency with industry-standard simulation tools (e.g., PowerFactory, PSCAD/EMTDC, MATLAB/Simulink) and programming in Python, MATLAB, or similar environments* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience in data analytics/AI/ML considered an advantage; fluent English required, German a plusAbout the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. jobs.occupation: Position for doctoral candidate (Dr. rer. nat. / PhD) in infectious disease immunology (m/f/x) fo... (Mikrobiologe/-biologin)
jobs.description: The Friedrich-Alexander-University (FAU) Erlangen-Nürnberg has been rated as one of the most innovative universities in Europe by Reuters or Times Higher Education. FAU and the University Hospital Erlangen (UKER) , which are located in the City of Erlangen in the North of Bavaria, Germany, carry out top-level research in immunology and have consistently ranked among the most successful German universities in attracting funding from the German Research Foundation ( Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft, DFG ) in the medical field of "Microbiology, Virology and Immunology". The FAU Profile Center Immunomedicine (FAU I-Med) unites more than 130 independent research groups from FAU, the UKER and the Max Planck Center for Physics and Medicine, which participate in numerous DFG-funded research  consortia and provide a strong scientific environment.One of these DFG-funded research consortia is the Research Training Group (RTG; Graduiertenkolleg, GRK) 2740 "ImmunoMicroTope" , which has been headed by Prof. Christian Bogdan since 2022. It is run by 13 outstanding research group leaders of the University Hospital Erlangen and the FAU and maintains close cooperations with two laboratories at the Universities of Regensburg and Cologne. The RTG 2740 focuses on the in situ analysis of the tissue microenvironment, the micromilieu factors and the metabolites that determine the immune response against bacterial, parasitic and fungal pathogens. The overarching goal of the consortium is the characterization of the complex "immunomicrotope" during infections (Bogdan et al., Trends in Parasitology 2024 10.1016/j.pt.2024.07.013 ( https://doi.org/10.1016/j.pt.2024.07.013 ) ).Your tasks:Within the RTG2740 "ImmunoMicroTope ", Prof. Christian Bogdan offers a PhD position in his dynamic research team in the project B2 "Role of sex and microbiota for the curative effect of L-arginine in chronic cutaneous leishmaniasis due to Leishmania mexicana infection".Type 2 nitric oxide synthase (NOS2) converts the amino acid L-arginine in the presence of molecular oxygen into nitric oxide (NO), which exerts antimicrobial and immunoregulatory functions. In previous studies, Prof. Bogdan's group showed that NOS2 is essential for the type 1 T helper cell-dependent control of intracellular pathogens, including the protozoan parasite Leishmania. In contrast, the expression of arginase 1 correlated with the progression of disease, pathogen persistence and immunopathology. Moreover, the group observed that the non-healing, chronic course of cutaneous leishmaniasis in Leishmania mexicana- infected female mice was prevented and reversed by external application of L-arginine. Currently, it is unclear, whether this effect is sex-dependent and whether it is influenced by the cutaneous and/or intestinal microbiota. The project aims to address these questions and to provide new mechanistic insights into the therapeutic effect of L-arginine with the ultimate goal to establish a new host-targeted treatment for chronic cutaneous leishmaniasis.For more information, please visit www.immunomicrotope.de ( https://www.immunomicrotope.de/beispiel-seite/project-areas/project-area-b-metabolism/b2-characterization-and-integrative-bioinformatic-modeling-of-metabolic-and-micro-milieu-factors-promoting-leishmania-survival/ ) and www.mikrobiologie.uk-erlangen.de/en/research/research-groups/research-group-of-prof-c-bogdan ( https://www.mikrobiologie.uk-erlangen.de/forschung/forschergruppen-arbeitsgruppen/ag-prof-c-bogdan/ ) /.( http://www.immunomicrotope.de/ )Essential experience/qualifications:- Master’s Degree in immunology or a related subject of life sciences (e.g., microbiology/microbiome research, parasitology, cell biology)- Excellent academic performance and high level of scientific interest- Practical and theoretical experience in the field of infectious disease immunology and microbiome analyses- Very good knowledge of bioinformatic programs and experience in bioinformatic analyses- Experience in mammalian cell culture, cell and molecular biology methods (e.g., flow cytometry, RNA/DNA isolation, quantitative PCR, ChIP, bulk and scRNAseq) and fluorescence (confocal) microscopy- Enthusiasm for experimental and bioinformatic work and for establishing new experimental methods and techniques- High responsibility, initiative, ambition, and motivation- Team spirit- Very good English language skills (C1 level or higher)- Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, Prism, Illustrator etc.Additionally beneficial are:- Experience with experimental in vivo mouse models- FELASA B certificate- Experience with imaging methods- Experience in the field of parasitology- Knowledge of the German languageComments:- The program starts on July 1 st 2027- The PhD position is available for initially 36 months- Pay grade is determined according to the qualifications and personal requirements as defined by TV-L E13- Please provide a single PDF file (last name_first name.pdf ) consisting of the following documents in English language:- Completed application form (RTG 2740 Application form_PhD; www.immunomicrotope.de ( https://www.immunomicrotope.de/how-to-apply/ ) )- Curriculum vitae- Letter of motivation- One-page summary each of the bachelor and master thesis- Copies of the university entrance exam, Bachelor exam and Master exam- Two letters of reference- Other credentials and information relevant to the RTG2740 programPlease note that applications that do not fulfill these formal requirements, will not be considered. Deadline for application is January 15, 2027. The recruitment symposium will take place at the end of February 2027.We offer:- Participation in the 3-year qualification program of the RTG2740, which combines profound, internationally oriented scientific training with an early exposure to important aspects of translational research- Well equipped lab with access to the latest technologies (e.g., bulk and scRNA sequencing; microbiome analysis; confocal, light sheet and high-resolution microscopy; transcriptomics) and core-facilities- A stimulating, collaborative, and international research environment formed by the FAU Profile Center Immunomedicine ( https://www.immunology.fau.de/ ), various collaborative research consortia, and the Max-Planck-Center for Physics and Medicine- Continuous supervision and advice by a scientific mentoring committee- Participation in national and international workshops, symposia, conferences, and an international laboratory exchange- All public service benefits, including supplementary benefits from the Federal and State Government Pension Fund (VBL)Further information:Prof. Dr. Christian BogdanResearch group leader, head of the institute and spokesman of RTG2740Tel. +49 9131 8532561Dr. Ilka KnippertzScientific ManagingTel.: +49 9131 8532571Applications:Universitätsklinikum ErlangenInstitut für Klinische Mikrobiologie, Immunologie und HygieneProf. Dr. Christian BogdanWasserturmstraße 3-5D-91054 Erlangen, Germany
